spec2def(olesvr32.dll olesvr32.spec)

# olesvr32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/olesvr32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(olesvr32_shims OBJECT olesvr_main.c)
target_link_libraries(olesvr32_shims PRIVATE wine libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(olesvr32_shims)
add_cargo_module(olesvr32 olesvr32-cargo olesvr32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS olesvr32_shims psdk)
